title: Normalized scalar extension comparison on a pro-etale slice
statement: Let Y be any scheme and U an object of its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let R and S be sheaves of commutative rings on that site and c:R→S a morphism. Literal restriction M↦M|U, obtained by composition of pro-etale objects, is exact. There is a natural isomorphism (S⊗_R−)|U ≅ S|U⊗_{R|U}(−|U), sending every sheafification-unit pure tensor s⊗m to the identical restricted pure tensor. Its degreewise extension has the same components. For the unbounded left derived scalar extension of [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], there is an isomorphism L(c_*) followed by derived restriction ≅ derived restriction followed by L((c|U)_*), and the square with the universal derived counits and the degreewise ordinary comparison commutes. No flatness of c, boundedness, or noetherianity of Y or U is assumed.

proof.text: Identify the pro-etale site of U with the localization of the site of Y at U. On presheaves, composing the scalar tensor presheaf with the localization forgetful functor gives the scalar tensor presheaf after restriction, on both objects and maps.

Restriction to a localized site commutes with sheafification and tensor. The universal sheafification-unit equation determines the ordinary scalar-extension comparison, whose value on s tensor m is the same pure tensor over the restricted coefficient map. Naturality gives an isomorphism of functors. Applying it degree by degree gives the complex comparison and component formula.

Choose a flat-term K-flat resolution P of any unbounded complex. Exact slice restriction preserves the resolution quasi-isomorphism. Ringed-topos pullback preserves flat-term K-flat complexes, so the restriction of P computes the restricted derived scalar extension. Compute the two derived composites on P using the ordinary comparison. The universal property of left derived functors extends this natural comparison to an isomorphism on derived categories, and its defining commutation with the universal counits is the normalization equation.

No hits; changeOfRings was not known to the search index. Direct reading of Mathlib sheaf change-of-rings and continuous pushforward, plus the proved localized tensor module, found no theorem giving this scalar/derived comparison.

No hits in Mathlib. Direct rg of Sheaf/AlgebraicGeometry and Sheaf/Paper likewise found no pro-etale scalar-extension/slice comparison. Existing localized tensor restriction is a needed ordinary tensor tool, not the unbounded scalar extension/counit statement. Also read RingedSliceNormalizedComparisons (fixed-ring derived tensor/Hom, with comparison model hypotheses), SliceScalarHomChainAdjunction (ordinary slice scalar comparison plus chain Hom, no derived square), RingedSliceDerivedMate (generic derived mate with extra inverse-image and right-derived presentations), and SliceModuleSheafification. None directly supplies the normalized scalar-extension comparison for the selected pro-etale pbc functors.
